title: 악마성 드라큘라 X 월하의 야상곡
prompt:
INPUT: text only — no reference image is needed; do not reuse earlier conversation images.

GAME: «악마성 드라큘라 X 월하의 야상곡» (Castlevania: Symphony of the Night), 1997. Genre: action. Graphics era: 16-bit console and early PC.

NOT ITS CHARACTERS: an original woman who is the game itself — no face or body of its hero, mascot, characters or creatures (she may wear their outfits); no title logo, box art, real brands, HUD overlay or readable text and numbers. Its items, places, colors, gear and interface shapes may appear recognizably.

STYLE: Glossy Korean mobile-game character art with an elegant anime face, smooth dimensional shading, luminous color accents and refined costume and accessory rendering. Keep highlights selective and the figure sharply readable.

SIGNATURE (recognizable, as the game shows them): "달빛 아래 솟은 고딕 성", "안이 붉은 검푸른 긴 망토", "은빛 촛대", "박쥐 떼".

Quoted notes may be Korean; read them as description, never render them as text.

SUBJECT: one adult woman who personifies the video game itself. Persona: "백 년 만에 다시 떠오른 성을 홀로 거닐며, 피로 이어진 아버지의 그림자와 맞서는 고요한 반혈의 검객". Desire: "다시 떠오른 성을 잠재우는 것"; conflict: "피의 유산과 스스로 고른 길". Its symbols become costume motifs drawn the way the game shows them, worn, not carried, unless her form or pose puts one in hand: "거꾸로 선 성", "안이 붉은 망토", "보름달".

AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) whatever her expression.

CORE PLAY: "넓은 성을 이리저리 뛰며 길을 넓히고, 모은 장비와 변신(박쥐·늑대·안개)으로 막힌 곳을 지난다" — shown in her bearing and small costume details, never as effects, numbers or a HUD.

ERA LOOK: 16-bit era — richer color gradients in the fabric, layered sprite-like accents, saturated jewel tones — in fabric and trim only, never pixel art or a screenshot.

SILHOUETTE: lean and long-legged, with a natural neck length build; long straight hair; silver-white hair; garment structure: a wrapped cloak; main material: deep navy velvet lined in crimson, trimmed with tarnished silver filigree; palette: midnight navy, moon silver and blood-crimson lining.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): long face; narrow upturned eyes; sharp angled brows; aquiline nose; small bow lips; gold eyes; broad European ancestry with individual variation, no stereotyped features.

FORM — TITLE (타이틀): "성문 앞 — 안이 붉은 검푸른 긴 망토, 은 장식이 든 높은 깃, 허리의 가는 장검". Battle role: scout. Stage of play: the first power-on — her cleanest look, genre colors most vivid.
GEAR in the game's own style: "안이 붉은 긴 망토".

SETTING (this form): "달빛이 비치는 성 입구의 무너진 돌다리" — calm start-screen composition — centered, uncluttered, cool clean light, dark negative space.

HOLD BACK: these moments belong to the open images — keep their events out of this setting, even as a distant figure or reflection: "구름 사이로 보름달이 떠오르며 호수 위로 고딕 성이 솟아오른다"; "회랑의 촛불이 한꺼번에 꺼지며 박쥐 떼가 소용돌이처럼 날아오른다"; "성 전체가 천천히 뒤집히며 발밑 하늘로 붉은 달이 떠오른다". An object named in FORM or in her pose stays.

EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the FORM costume, material and palette.

PRESENTATION: a polished, glamorous adult game card illustration — a beautiful face within her FACE structure; a dense, high-detail costume with glossy trim, clasps and jewelry framing her game's material; luminous rim light, strong value contrast.

STANCE (this form): "망토 자락을 한 팔로 걷어 올리며 무너진 다리 끝에서 어깨 너머로 돌아보는 자세" — held still and centered, seen at eye level, easy to read as a card.

LOOK-BACK: head turns at most a quarter over the shoulder; face three-quarter or profile, never full-front on a turned-away torso.

EXPRESSION (TITLE): relaxed brow, softly open eyes, lips closed and unstrained, no smile — the mood of this stage, on her own face.

OUTPUT: one full-body card image of this form, which also fixes who she is for every later form. Vertical 2:3 frame (1024×1536), full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, nothing in front of her but what she holds, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). Build the background from SETTING; it evokes her game's world without being a screenshot or level map.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border, no game interface or score.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Her hands do only what STANCE says and hold only what it names.
